svg.title: Tenohira Musei — The Voiceless Hand. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Waxing Crescent forks into Unspoken Blow then Deafening Silence, or Held Breath then Tipping the Balance. Waning Crescent forks into Hushed Inferno then Eclipse in Hand, or Bared to the Moon then Stillness Breaks. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu.

Waxing Crescent answers \"How do I make my own strikes count for more?\": Deafening Silence hits harder on every cast, Tipping the Balance charges both self buffs for their windows. Waning Crescent answers \"How do I weaken them?\": Eclipse in Hand blunts their hits, Stillness Breaks bares them to every hit. The Defensive and Control rows (seal, buff and debuff prevention, move) are unsupported. Roster pass: Quiet Opening (+3% Increase Damage Taken) twinned Bared to the Moon, so it returned to its pre-batch name and job as Unspoken Blow (+1 Damage) and Deafening Silence went +2 \u2192 +1 (route +2); Waxing Crescent +3 \u2192 +2% and Tipping the Balance +5 \u2192 +4% (Amplifier +10 \u2192 +8%); Bared to the Moon +3 \u2192 +2% and Stillness Breaks +4 \u2192 +3% (Exposure +9 \u2192 +7%). The final review raised Deafening Silence back to +2 (route +3); the final cleanup returns it to +1 (edge route +2, 40 \u2192 42) under the batch's +2 flat-Damage limit, and Eclipse in Hand drops its +2% Increase Damage Given rider (no offensive rider on a suppression capstone). Graph and names unchanged.","Edge commit: no percentage setup fits under Waxing Crescent. Increase Damage Given twins Held Breath (01+02+03+04 stacks it); Increase Damage Taken was the first pass's Quiet Opening, which left the capstone-less 01+02+06+09 one point under Stillness Breaks; Decrease Damage Given does not set up a strike. Exposure is one point under Amplifier because Moonlit Inferno and Cascade (100 AP) put both exposure rows live for the same two rounds from one turn and also lift allies' hits, while Rift and Cascade (120 AP) need two turns and overlap one round. Suppression is one single-target row, so it keeps +10% (\u00d70.846) with no rider. Tipping the Balance's +2% Decrease Damage Given is the yin-yang 'balance' (yang pools in the hand as yin drains from the target), a small defensive secondary on the Moonlit cast the route already wants. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2 (40 \u2192 42), Increase Damage Given +8%, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +7%; the top offensive package (01+04+05+06) is \u00d71.156.","Resolver and delivery (\u00a73, \u00a73b, \u00a74b): stat filters on an element-less row bind only on elemental hits. Such a row matches every element-less hit of any stat type, and an elemental hit only when the row lists that hit's stat type; 'Highest' is the caster's highest offence, also on an enemy debuff. Cascade's exposure row (Highest) matches the caster's own strikes, but an ally's elemental hit only if it uses the Tenohira caster's highest offence stat. In the in-kit solo rotation (R1 Moonlit Inferno + Cascade at 100 AP, R2 Rift, R3 Palm Strike; compounding IDG/IDT on the strikes) the three offense packages total 298.0 (Edge + Waning Crescent; 296.3 with Held Breath), 300.9 (Amplifier + Waning Crescent) and 301.9 (Exposure + Waxing Crescent) strike power against a 271.3 baseline; the best capstone-less build (01+02+06+09) gives 298.2. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Tipping the Balance path + Unspoken Blow
Eclipse in Hand path + Waxing Crescent
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE TENOHIRA MUSEI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree
